verdict.rationale: OpenClaw has its own public skills and plugin registry, ClawHub, with documented discovery, install, update, publish and CLI search flows. A community report that the 'top skill' on the registry was a malware installer confirms the marketplace is populated and ranked, though it also signals curation problems. Nothing in the evidence shows scale ('thousands') or the health of maintainers. missing for 10: evidence of the number of published skills/plugins, evidence of active maintainer activity, independent corroboration of ecosystem vitality and quality.
